decisions.reason: Because this burner component remains tightly linked to the firm's established radiant-heater know-how, installed base and service capabilities, management is more likely to retain it as a supporting core product than withdraw it despite the shift toward newer low-carbon lines.

As a flagship electric infrared line that fits the firm's heating expertise and strategic move toward integrated lower-carbon building-climate solutions, it is very likely to be kept and further improved through in-house R&D.

This industrial electric infrared hall-heater line is close to the firm's core application knowledge in large non-residential spaces, so accumulated market feedback can be absorbed and used for refinement rather than exit.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater combines strong relatedness to the firm's existing combustion and radiant-heating knowledge with clear alignment to its hydrogen-ready direction, making continued commercialization highly likely.
